description: Zeenah is the Team Lead and Tech Lead for SonicSpace, an accessibility-focused project built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. As a developer and innovator, she specializes in translating complex Earth observation data into intuitive, multi-sensory experiences. Driven by a mission to make STEM and space data accessible to everyone including the visually impaired Zeenah is leading the architecture of SonicSpace's sonification engine and interactive frontend.
